title: Eber
summary: A full-stack ride-booking platform with live trip tracking, Stripe payments and an admin dashboard.
highlights: Live ride tracking and ride request events over WebSockets and Socket.IO
Browser push notifications through Service Workers, plus PWA support
Admin dashboard with ride history, filtering, CSV export and Google Maps routes

narrative.problem: Ride booking involves riders, drivers and admins at once, and each needs to see trip state change as it happens, from driver assignment through billing.
narrative.constraints: Real-time updates across web clients, a complete ride lifecycle from assignment to invoice, and third-party services for payments and notifications such as Stripe, Twilio and Nodemailer.
narrative.decision: An Angular PWA talks to a Node.js, Express and MongoDB backend: REST APIs cover the ride lifecycle, Socket.IO pushes live tracking and request events, and Service Workers deliver browser push notifications.
narrative.result: A deployed ride-booking platform with live tracking, Stripe payments and multi-channel notifications, plus an admin dashboard with ride history, filtering, CSV export and Google Maps trip visualization.

lines: driver assigned → en route → arrived at pickup
implementation.summary: Every ride moves through distinct lifecycle phases exposed as REST APIs and verified with Postman, and admins review the outcomes in a ride-history module.
